F2-L06.intro: Polite classroom Arabic: ask for things, ask permission, say sorry and thank you — and choose the right form every time: مِنْ فَضْلِكَ / مِنْ فَضْلِكِ، تَفَضَّلْ / تَفَضَّلِي، آسِفٌ / آسِفَةٌ، يَا أُسْتَاذُ / يَا أُسْتَاذَةُ.

tasks.task: ASK your teacher for a pen, politely — to a woman (she then answers).
ASK her to repeat the question — to a woman (she then answers).
tasks.help: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُعِيدِي …، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ؟
tasks.model: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُعِيدِي السُّؤَالَ، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ؟
tasks.en: Could you repeat the question, please? (to a woman)

tasks.task: Apologise and ask permission to come in.
tasks.help: أَنَا آسِفٌ يَا أُسْتَاذُ. هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ …؟
tasks.model: أَنَا آسِفٌ يَا أُسْتَاذُ. هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ أَدْخُلَ؟
tasks.en: I am sorry, Sir. May I come in?

tasks.task: Say sorry, it is at home, and ask to read with a classmate.
tasks.help: آسِفٌ، كِتَابِي فِي … هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ …؟
tasks.model: آسِفٌ، كِتَابِي فِي البَيْتِ. هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ مَعَ زَمِيلِي؟
tasks.en: Sorry, my book is at home. May I read with my classmate?

tasks.examiner: … نَعَمْ، لَا بَأْسَ، الجَوُّ حَارٌّ اليَوْمَ.
tasks.task: ASK if you may open the window (the teacher then answers).
tasks.help: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ أَفْتَحَ …، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟
tasks.model: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ أَفْتَحَ النَّافِذَةَ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟
tasks.en: May I open the window, please?
The bus was late; I am very sorry.

tasks.task: Tell Hana what to say, and why (speak to her as a girl: قُولِي).
tasks.help: قُولِي: «… مِنْ فَضْلِكِ يَا أُسْتَاذَةُ»، لِأَنَّ …
tasks.model: قُولِي: «… مِنْ فَضْلِكِ يَا أُسْتَاذَةُ»، لِأَنَّ المُعَلِّمَةَ امْرَأَةٌ.
tasks.en: Say: “… please, Miss”, because the teacher is a woman.
We say “min faḍlika yā ustādh”, with a fatha.

tasks.task: Give her two options, for a female and a male teacher.
tasks.help: قُولِي: «… تُعِيدِي؟» لِلْمُعَلِّمَةِ، أَوْ «… تُعِيدَ؟» لِلْمُعَلِّمِ
tasks.model: قُولِي: «لَا أَفْهَمُ، هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُعِيدِي؟» لِلْمُعَلِّمَةِ، أَوْ «هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُعِيدَ؟» لِلْمُعَلِّمِ.
tasks.en: Say: “I don’t understand, could you repeat?” with “tuʿīdī” to a female teacher, or “tuʿīda” to a male teacher.

tasks.task: ASK if she has any other questions — to a girl (she then answers).
tasks.en: Do you have another question? (to a girl)

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected question with two options.
tasks.en: We say “ʿafwan”, or “no thanks needed for a duty”.

conversation.qen: How do you say “please” to a male teacher?
And how do you say it to a female teacher?
What do you say when you don’t understand?
What do you say after “thank you”?
Politely ask your (male) friend for a pen.
conversation.starter: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ آخُذَ … ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟ شُكْرًا!
conversation.model: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ آخُذَ قَلَمَكَ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟ شُكْرًا!
conversation.en: May I take your pen, please? Thank you!

conversation.model: أَنَا آسِفٌ يَا أُسْتَاذُ، تَأَخَّرْتُ اليَوْمَ.
conversation.en: I am sorry, Sir, I was late today.
Here you are, this is your book. (to a girl)

conversation.q: كَيْفَ يَقُولُ الوَلَدُ «sorry»؟ وَكَيْفَ تَقُولُهُ البِنْتُ؟
conversation.qen: How does a boy say “sorry”? And a girl?
conversation.model: الوَلَدُ يَقُولُ «أَنَا آسِفٌ»، وَالبِنْتُ تَقُولُ «أَنَا آسِفَةٌ».
conversation.en: A boy says “anā āsif”, and a girl says “anā āsifa”.

conversation.q: لِمَاذَا اللُّغَةُ المُهَذَّبَةُ مُهِمَّةٌ فِي الصَّفِّ؟
conversation.qen: Why is polite language important in class?
conversation.model: لِأَنَّهَا تُظْهِرُ الاِحْتِرَامَ لِلْمُعَلِّمِ وَلِلزُّمَلَاءِ، وَتَجْعَلُ الصَّفَّ مَكَانًا لَطِيفًا.
conversation.en: Because it shows respect for the teacher and classmates, and makes the class a pleasant place.

conversation.q: اُطْلُبْ مِنَ المُعَلِّمَةِ أَنْ تَتَكَلَّمَ بِبُطْءٍ.
conversation.qen: Ask the (female) teacher to speak slowly.
conversation.starter: يَا أُسْتَاذَةُ، هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تَتَكَلَّمِي … ، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ؟ …
conversation.model: يَا أُسْتَاذَةُ، هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تَتَكَلَّمِي بِبُطْءٍ، مِنْ فَضْلِكِ؟ لَا أَفْهَمُ جَيِّدًا.
conversation.en: Miss, could you speak slowly, please? I don’t understand well.

conversation.q: مَاذَا تَقُولُ لِمَجْمُوعَةٍ مِنَ الضُّيُوفِ فِي الصَّفِّ؟
conversation.qen: What do you say to a group of guests in class?
conversation.model: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! تَفَضَّلُوا، اِجْلِسُوا مِنْ فَضْلِكُمْ.
conversation.en: Welcome! Please come in and sit down. (to a group)

conversation.qen: You forgot your book. What do you say to the teacher?
conversation.starter: يَا أُسْتَاذُ، أَنَا آسِفٌ، نَسِيتُ … هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ …؟ …
conversation.model: يَا أُسْتَاذُ، أَنَا آسِفٌ، نَسِيتُ كِتَابِي فِي البَيْتِ. هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ مَعَ زَمِيلِي؟ شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا.
conversation.en: Sir, I am sorry, I forgot my book at home. May I read with my classmate? Thank you very much.
